annotation.cut_point:
We are given the polynomial:

$$
(x^2 + 1)(x - 2)^9 = a_0 + a_1x + a_2x^2 + \ldots + a_{11}x^{11}
$$

We are to find the sum:

$$
a_1 + a_2 + a_3 + \ldots + a_{11}
$$

---

### Step 1: Understand the structure

Let’s define:

$$
P(x) = (x^2 + 1)(x - 2)^9
$$

We are to find the sum of coefficients from $ x^1 $ up to $ x^{11} $, i.e., $ S = a_1 + a_2 + \ldots + a_{11} $

This is equivalent to evaluating $ P(1) $, since:

$$
a_k = P(k)
$$
